scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace=@prompt-battle/api" "npm run dev:worker --workspace=@prompt-battle/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@prompt-battle/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/core && npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/openrouter && npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/api && npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/core && npm run build --workspace=@prompt-battle/openrouter && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start:local: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run start --workspace=@prompt-battle/api" "npm run start:worker --workspace=@prompt-battle/api" "npm run start --workspace=@prompt-battle/web"
